title: Reimpliment Details Panel Single-Line Overflow
description: Strict reimplementation of the single-line overflow behavior in the Details panel. Fix: padding mismatch between single-line CollapsedFieldDisplay and actual input (missing px-single/h-medium causes wrong overflow threshold and height jump), reduce double-chevron indicator to a single centered chevron.
summary: Completed the shared Details row-anchor fix by moving header-line anchoring onto the actual runtime TreeRow path used by showLabel controls. TreeRow now detects property-style children and pins the gutter elbow to the fixed header line, while direct property-row Label and HelperRow paths keep the same anchor. Extended the existing UI tests with a TreeRow plus showLabel case and reverified builds.
